title: Warm Illusion V Framed Print
text: Light fades solid metals into an illusion of warmth and security—Warm Illusion features interactive compositions that evoke landscapes intended to take form in the viewer’s imagination. Artist Alex Del Rio’s controlled light source on each curated surface results in a symbiotic relationship between the spontaneity of painting and the mechanical nature of photography. After many years of editorial collaborations, photographer Alex Del Rio continues to travel with curiosity to cover different stories around the globe. Icebreaker sounds in Lapland and dunes swallowing the road in Morocco are just a few of the memories that he owes to his camera. High-quality print on artist’s paper under a crystal clear, American-made Acrylite ® frame-grade acrylic panel. Surrounded by a black-finished wood frame, crafted in Indonesia. Polyester fibers encase the foam cushion cores to provide additional comfort. Cushion fill is completely sealed in a water-repellent covering with zip closure, featuring serged interior edges to enhance cushion strength and longevity. Woven of 100% solution dyed acrylic, Sunbrella® and Inside Out® fabrics are easy to care for, stain resistant, color fast, and provide up to 98% UV protection. Unlike yarn-dyed fabrics where the color is surface deep, solution-dying completely permeates fibers, resulting in colorfast fabrics that withstand even the harshest elements. text: This collection is crafted from sustainably harvested Grade-A teak wood, selected for its natural beauty and durability. Artisan-crafted teak finishes are hand-applied using a wire brush to subtly distress the wood followed by staining the pigment onto the surface. Small imperfections may expose underlying teak wood. If left uncovered, finishes will gradually fade and acquire a beautiful silvery-grey patina (typical of untreated teak wood), adding unique character to your piece. Teak hardwood contains natural oils that repel insects, prevent drying, and resist moisture. Teak is also resistant to fungal decay, rotting, and warping due to temperature or humidity. For natural teak pieces, the teak’s natural oils cause a natural occurrence called oil surfacing, in which teak oil will pool on the surfaces of new or very young natural teak, almost like a watermark pattern of discoloration. We recommend rinsing your teak furniture with a garden hose prior to first use. Protect your outdoor furnishings with resilient Agora® covers—specifically tailored to fit Arhaus outdoor collections. title: Leather Care Conditioner
text: Keep your leather upholstery looking its best with our gentle leather cleaner and conditioner. Its wax free formulation removes surface dirt and enhances the natural luster of the leather without masking its unique qualities. Safe for all colors. This product is made in the USA. Shake contents well. Always test in a hidden area before treating the entire item. Using a clean, non-colored soft cloth apply conditioner, let dry, and buff gently with a clean soft cloth. Always avoid exposure to direct heat or sunlight. Do not use on suede, nubuck or napped leathers. For OIL-BASED spills: Lift excess spill then blot with a clean, soft cloth. The oil should absorb completely into the leather. For LIQUID-BASED spills: Blot with a clean, soft cloth; wipe spot gently with a solution of one part mild soap and 10 parts distilled water; follow by wiping the entire area around the spill with distilled water and let air dry.

title: Kipton Wide Arm Swivel Chair in Nomad Snow
Kinnan Extended Bed
text: Crafted by our North Carolina upholstery artisans working with some of the finest materials sourced around the world. Frames are craftsman-built in America using cross-directional hardwood laminate certified by the Sustainable Forestry Initiative. Bed frames include space to accommodate variances in mattress sizes and allow bedding to be tucked in. The Kinnan Collection is available in multiple pieces and customizable fabrics and leathers. Call, email, or live chat with our Design Team to create your own. We want you to love your Kinnan as much as we do. We recommend ordering a material swatch prior to purchase, ensuring the perfect color choice.

title: Canyon Outdoor Teak Bar Table
text: This collection is crafted from sustainably harvested Grade-A teak wood, selected for its natural beauty and durability. Artisan-crafted teak finishes are hand-applied using a wire brush to subtly distress the wood followed by staining the pigment onto the surface. Small imperfections may expose underlying teak wood. If left uncovered, finishes will gradually fade and acquire a beautiful silvery-grey patina (typical of untreated teak wood), adding unique character to your piece. Teak hardwood contains natural oils that repel insects, prevent drying, and resist moisture. Teak is also resistant to fungal decay, rotting, and warping due to temperature or humidity. For natural teak pieces, the teak’s natural oils cause a natural occurrence called oil surfacing, in which teak oil will pool on the surfaces of new or very young natural teak, almost like a watermark pattern of discoloration. We recommend rinsing your teak furniture with a garden hose prior to first use. For a more cohesive look, pair our Canyon Bar Table with our Canyon Barstools or Counter Stools. Protect your outdoor furnishings with resilient Agora® covers—specifically tailored to fit Arhaus outdoor collections. Call, email, or live chat with our Design Team for details.

title: Finnley Powder Vanity
text: Craftsman-built from oak wood and marine-grade plywood with hand-applied finishes and include a stone top and oval ceramic undermount sink (P-trap not included). Thick, honed stone tops are constructed from Carrara marble or bluestone and are sealed for added protection. Natural stone surfaces feature unique variations in color and pattern. Natural mineral deposits, swirling, joint lines, veining, or other feature add character to each piece without affecting quality or performance. Drawers sit on under-mounted, soft-close glides and the soft-closing doors feature adjustable and removeable shelves behind them. Doors and drawers include hardware finished in your choice of Antique Brass or Polished Nickel. Countertops feature pre-drilled holes to accommodate standard 8" widespread deck-mount faucets (faucets sold separately). Back panel includes a 12" x 12" cutout or can be removed to accommodate any size plumbing. Professional installation by a licensed contractor and plumber is required. For added stability and safety, vanities include a French cleat wall mount on the back panel.

title: Hemmings Nesting Coffee Table Cluster in Black Marquina and Walnut

Tabletops feature reinforced engineered hardwood joinery to bases for added strength and stability. Black marquina marble tables are sourced from Italy and feature unique variations in color and pattern. Natural mineral deposits, swirling, joint lines, veining, or other feature add character to each piece without affecting quality or performance. Walnut pieces are crafted from walnut veener and may display small splits, knots, joint lines, or other features that will add character to your piece without affecting its quality or performance. Each table is finished with a clear lacquer for added protection and subtle sheen. This collection is artisan-crafted from natural materials with hand-applied finishes. Individual pieces may vary in color, pattern, shape, and texture, making each truly unique.

title: Canyon Outdoor Teak Swivel Chair in Shardai Zinc
text: Each piece includes a custom-fit cover and storage bag to protect your furniture. This collection is crafted from sustainably harvested Grade-A teak wood, selected for its natural beauty and durability. Canyon’s premium natural teak hardwood curated by Arhaus is untreated and unfinished; its organic color tones are honed by finely sanding into a smoothed surface. Natural teak highlights organic variations in color and graining. These characteristics may differ between pieces. Natural teak may display small splits, knots, joint lines, or other features, adding character to your piece without affecting its quality or performance. Over time, natural teak’s warm, golden color eventually fades to a silvery-grey patina. Weathering will begin immediately when left uncovered and in daylight. Pieces in our Weathered Fawn finish are hand-applied using a wire brush to subtly distress the wood followed by staining the pigment onto the surface. For Weathered Fawn pieces, small imperfections may expose underlying teak wood. If left uncovered, finishes will gradually fade and acquire a beautiful silvery-grey patina (typical of untreated teak wood), adding unique character to your piece. Teak hardwood contains natural oils that repel insects, prevent drying, and resist moisture. Teak is also resistant to fungal decay, rotting, and warping due to temperature or humidity. Crafted to withstand the elements, Canyon’s cushions have been engineered for maximum water drainage and air circulation. Canyon’s cushions are crafted from an open-cell, quick-dry foam wrapped in high-quality poly fibers made from recycled post-consumer plastics. Seat and back cushions feature a mesh bottom panel to allow water drainage and a zipper to easily remove the casing if needed. InsideOut Performance Fabrics ® are made from durable polyester and polypropylene fibers, which are bleach-cleanable, fade-resistant, anti-mildew, and eco-friendly. Fade- and mildew-resistant furniture covers are crafted from Agora® Compact Special Piedra composed of 100% solution-dyed acrylic and feature mesh ventilation and a water-repellent finish. Swivel mechanism allows for easy, effortless rotation.

title: Canyon Outdoor Teak Ottoman
text: This collection is crafted from sustainably harvested Grade-A teak wood, selected for its natural beauty and durability. Artisan-crafted teak finishes are hand-applied using a wire brush to subtly distress the wood followed by staining the pigment onto the surface. Small imperfections may expose underlying teak wood. If left uncovered, finishes will gradually fade and acquire a beautiful silvery-grey patina (typical of untreated teak wood), adding unique character to your piece. Teak hardwood contains natural oils that repel insects, prevent drying, and resist moisture. Teak is also resistant to fungal decay, rotting, and warping due to temperature or humidity. For natural teak pieces, the teak’s natural oils cause a natural occurrence called oil surfacing, in which teak oil will pool on the surfaces of new or very young natural teak, almost like a watermark pattern of discoloration. We recommend rinsing your teak furniture with a garden hose prior to first use. Crafted to withstand the elements, Canyon’s cushions have been engineered for maximum water drainage and air circulation. Canyon’s cushions are crafted from an open-cell, quick-dry foam wrapped in high-quality poly fibers made from recycled post-consumer plastics. Seat and back cushions feature a mesh bottom panel to allow water drainage and a zipper to easily remove the casing if needed. InsideOut Performance Fabrics are made from durable polyester and polypropylene fibers, which are bleach-cleanable, fade-resistant, anti-mildew, and eco-friendly. title: Emmons Outdoor Sofa in Eden Flax
text: This collection is crafted from oxidized aluminum and sustainably harvested teak wood, selected for its natural beauty and durability. Individual pieces may vary in color, pattern, shape and texture, making each truly unique. Our artisan partners in Mexico accentuate the natural teak wood’s characteristics—including splits and cracks—with a multi-step accelerated aging process which includes charring and cooling the wood, wire brushing, staining, and a matte finishing sealant. Artisan-crafted teak finishes are hand-applied using a wire brush to subtly distress the wood followed by a light stain and sealer that is applied to the surface. Small imperfections may expose underlying teak wood. title: Bal Harbour Outdoor Teak Sofa
text: This collection is crafted from sustainably harvested Grade-A teak wood, selected for its natural beauty and durability. Bal Harbour’s premium natural teak hardwood curated by Arhaus is untreated and unfinished; its organic color tones are honed by finely sanding into a smoothed surface. Natural teak highlights organic variations in color and graining. These characteristics may differ between pieces. Natural teak may display small splits, knots, joint lines, or other features, adding character to your piece without affecting its quality or performance. Teak hardwood contains natural oils that repel insects, prevent drying, and resist moisture. Teak is also resistant to fungal decay, rotting, and warping due to temperature or humidity. Over time, natural teak’s warm, golden color eventually fades to a silvery-grey patina. Weathering will begin immediately when left uncovered and in daylight. Crafted to withstand the elements, Bal Harbour’s cushions have been engineered for maximum water drainage and air circulation. title: Outdoor Teak Modular Kitchen Corner Cabinet
text: This collection is crafted from sustainably harvested Grade-A teak wood, selected for its natural beauty and durability. Premium natural teak hardwood curated by Arhaus is untreated and unfinished; its organic color tones are honed by finely sanding into a smoothed surface. Natural teak highlights organic variations in color and graining. These characteristics may differ between pieces. Natural teak may display small splits, knots, joint lines, or other features, adding character to your piece without affecting its quality or performance. Teak hardwood contains natural oils that repel insects, prevent drying, and resist moisture. Teak is also resistant to fungal decay, rotting, and warping due to temperature or humidity. Over time, natural teak’s warm, golden color eventually fades to a silvery-grey patina. Weathering will begin immediately when left uncovered and in daylight. Sintered stone tops are comprised of natural materials that are heat pressed to ensure a flat, nearly poreless surface that is scratch-, stain-, and heat-resistant. Cabinet doors swing out with a pull-to-open functionality. Features three interior shelves; two are adjustable and removable.
